variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables are declared with their type. Constants are declared with 'constant'.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Strongly typed. Includes Integer, Float, Boolean, Character. Custom ranges can be defined for strict bounds checking.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Standard arithmetic and logical operators. Equality is =, inequality is /=.

conditionals.title: Conditionals

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Iterates over a discrete range. Loop variable is implicitly declared and immutable.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Standard while loop. Must include loop variants in SPARK for formal proof of termination.

functions.title: Functions
functions.code:
function Add (A, B : Integer) return Integer with
   Pre => A < Integer'Last - B,
   Post => Add'Result = A + B
is
begin
   return A + B;
end Add;
functions.notes: Functions return values. SPARK heavily uses Pre/Post contracts for formal verification.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays have explicit bounds. Initialized using aggregates like (others => 0).

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: No built-in map primitive, but SPARK 2014 includes formal container libraries for verification.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.code:
pragma Restrictions (No_Exceptions);
-- SPARK programs generally prove absence of runtime errors statically.
error_handling.notes: Traditional exception handling is often forbidden in SPARK. Instead, the prover verifies statically that runtime errors (like overflow or null dereference) cannot occur.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: SPARK provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: SPARK supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: SPARK provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: SPARK converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: SPARK represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: SPARK formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: SPARK branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: SPARK defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: SPARK iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: SPARK organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: SPARK stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: SPARK groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: SPARK tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: SPARK organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
